विणश्यत् mfn. (-श्यन्-श्यन्ती-श्यत्) Perishing, decaying, perishable.
 E. वि, नश् to perish, शतृ aff.

वीणा f. (-णा)
 1. The Vīṇā, or Indian lute, a fretted instrument of the
guitar kind, usually having seven wires or strings, and a large
gourd at each end of the finger board; the extent of the instru-
ment is two octaves: it is supposed to be the invention of
NĀRADA, the son of BRAHMĀ, and has many varieties, enumer-
ated according to the number of strings, &c.
 2. Lightning.
 E. वी
to go, &c., Unādi aff. न, form irr.; or अज्-नक् वीभावः पृषो०
णत्वम् ।

वीणादण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The neck of a Vina.
 E. वीणा a lute, दण्ड a stick.

वीणानुबन्ध m. (-न्धः) The tie of a lute or lower part of the tail piece,
where the wires are fixed.
 E. वीणा the lute, अनुबन्ध appendage, tie,

वीणावाद m. (-दः) A player on the Vīṇā, a lutanist.
 E. वीणा a lute, and
वाद who causes to speak or sound; also with कन् added, वीणावादक ।

वीणास्य m. (-स्यः) NĀRADA, the son of BRAHMĀ, and inventor of the
Vīṇā or lute.
 E. वीणा, and आस्य the countenance.
